expressions.title: The Air Force Validation of Discharges Act, 1952
expressions.title_basis: p1 (Gazette of Pakistan Extra., December 13, 1952, p.1278; block 1997056 the running head) block 1997057 prints 'ACT No. XLV OF 1952 / An Act to validate certain discharges of airmen from the Royal Pakistan Air Force'; s.1(1) (block 1997062) 'This Act may be called the Air Force Validation of Discharges Act, 1952'; it ends at s.3 Indemnity '...so far as concerns the validity of the same.' (block 1997073, a block the extractor merged with the next heading 'ACT No. XLVI OF 1952 An'). Blocks 1997074-1997088 are the head of ACT No. XLVI of 1952 (Royal Pakistan Air Force (Extension of Service) Act, 1952: long title, s.1, s.2 and its first proviso), cut off at the end of this one-page PDF -- a fragment, set aside as apparatus; that Act is printed complete in document 8856 (owner policy q1 'split').
